answer: The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 10 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. Because the saffron beacon round is committed in advance, the wharf audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the crystal value does not exist until the window has already shut. That is 12 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
